subject_definitions:
Photorealistic cinematic drama, approximately ten seconds, natural restrained performance. Only two people, no duplicate figures or reference-sheet collages. <Subject 1> is Su Wan, the woman in <Picture 1>, with the same face, long straight dark hair, navy strapless denim top, dark jeans, black pointed shoes and silver necklace. <S1> is her warm, clear adult female Mandarin voice. <Subject 2> is Zhou Yan, the man in <Picture 2>, with the same face, short dark hair, trimmed beard, white tank top, white shorts, white sneakers, silver necklace and black watch. <S2> is his low, calm adult male Mandarin voice. Preserve identities, clothes, voices and accent across every segment. Each quoted line is spoken only by its designated visible speaker, with synchronized lips and no simultaneous speech.
<Picture 3> is the rainy high-rise living room. <Picture 4> is the separate morning abandoned street with vines, overhead wires and a stationary rusty orange-white sedan on the right. Keep these environments separate. The parked sedan is Zhou Yan's late father's old car; it remains stationary with doors closed throughout.
There is exactly ONE slim black smartphone, held in Su Wan's RIGHT hand throughout this story. It is never given to Zhou Yan, never pocketed and never duplicated. His hands are always empty. There are no keys, envelopes or additional handheld objects. Avoid readable phone UI text. Local timestamps refer only to this segment. No subtitles, narration or background music.
Current environment: Rainy living room from <Picture 3>. Woman screen left, man screen right, window behind them, one meter apart.

summary:
Su Wan has discovered a photograph of the old street and recognizes a car. Zhou Yan identifies it as his father's.

retention_analysis:
Both stand in the living room at night. Su Wan holds the ONLY black phone in her RIGHT hand at waist level, screen facing herself, with an old street photograph showing a small orange-white car. Zhou Yan has empty hands. They have not discussed the photograph yet.

detailed_description:
0-1: Establish a medium two-shot, woman left and man right.
1-4: Su Wan raises the phone in her RIGHT hand and angles its screen toward Zhou Yan without handing it over: <S1><d>[Chinese] 旧街这辆车，你认识吗？</d>
4-7.5: He leans slightly to look at her phone, keeping his hands lowered: <S2><d>[Chinese] 我爸的。他以前开它接我放学。</d>
7.5-end: Su Wan looks from the screen to him and listens quietly. Hold the two-shot.
END: phone remains in her RIGHT hand at chest height angled toward him. Man's hands empty. Woman left, man right, still indoors.

overall_soundscape:
Light rain outside the window, soft indoor room tone, intimate clear voices.

summary:
Su Wan takes one photograph of Zhou Yan standing beside his father's old car.

detailed_description:

summary:
She shows him the new photograph. They choose to preserve a memory without pretending the past has returned.

retention_analysis:
The photograph has ALREADY been taken once. Su Wan stands about two meters away on the road holding the ONE phone in her RIGHT hand. Zhou Yan waits beside the parked car with empty hands. Do not repeat the photo-taking or produce another phone. Car stays closed and still.

detailed_description:
0-2.5: Su Wan walks the two meters back to Zhou Yan, stopping to his LEFT. She keeps the phone in her RIGHT hand and tilts it so both can look down at the new photograph. Phone screen need not be legible.
2.5-4.5: She smiles gently: <S1><d>[Chinese] 拍好了。你看，像不像以前？</d>
4.5-7.5: Zhou Yan looks at the screen, then at the car, responding warmly: <S2><d>[Chinese] 不像。我长大了。今天这张，也留着。</d>

END: woman left, man right, both outside beside the same car; phone in her RIGHT hand; his hands empty; no vehicle movement. One new photograph has been saved.
